reassessment.memo: ∠AOB = 132° subtends the minor arc AB; C stands on the major arc. The centre angle is twice the angle at C, so ∠ACB = 132° ÷ 2 = 66°. A, C, B, D lie on one circle; ∠ACB and ∠ADB are opposite cyclic angles. Opposite cyclic angles sum to 180°, so ∠ADB = 180° − 66°. Answer: ∠ADB = 114°. Check: 66° + 114° = 180°.
